text: After supervised finetuning, the authors further train their debater and consultant models with multiple iterations of a modified Direct Preference Optimization chosen over PPO for ease of implementation and tuning. Because standard DPO uses only discrete preferences, they modify it to use the AI judge's output probabilities (the exact reward) rather than discarding that information.
title: Self-play debate training with a reward-aware DPO variant using judge probabilities
